before.requirement: With vertex-color fallback disabled, accept an OBJ vertex without RGB components without supplying fallback colors.
before.reason: The loader has a disabled-fallback path, but the supplied evidence does not establish whether the harness's default configuration selects it.

after.requirement: With vertex-color fallback disabled, accept an OBJ vertex without RGB components without supplying fallback colors.
after.reason: The changed loader retains the disabled-fallback path. The missing configuration default prevents determining whether the same old harness reaches it.

claims.reason: The harness default-constructs ObjReaderConfig on both sides and provides no input-controlled way to change vertex_color. Whether that is a shared blocker depends on the unsupplied default.
